skill.workedExample: Watch me make the scale level. Both sides need the same value, not the same number of tiles.
Watch me build a graph. Every column starts on the bottom line, and each square is the same size.
Watch me measure. Each unit touches the last one: no gaps, no overlaps.
Watch me move. I say each number as I land on it. Then it's your turn.
Watch me find the core: the part that repeats. Then I keep the pattern going.
Watch me look at the shapes: their sides, their corners, and how they move.
Watch me fill the ten-frame one counter at a time. Then it's your turn.
Watch me build a bridge. I fill up to 10 first, then I add the rest.
Watch me build a number. Ten ones snap into one ten.
Watch me pay. I start with the biggest coin that fits, and count on.
Watch me look at the spinner. The bigger the part, the more likely it lands there.
Watch me plant equal rows. Every row has the same number of trees, so I can count by rows.
Watch me move on the hundred chart. One row down is 10 more: same column, the tens grow.
Watch me jump on the open line. I jump to a friendly number first, then the rest.
